items: ✈️ **Oct:** Attended **ASE** in Munich, Germany! Great to reconnect with colleagues and exchange ideas with the software engineering community.
Received the **ACM SIGSOFT CAPS Travel Award** to support my conference participation.
🎉 **ASE:** Two papers accepted! Our work on *inclusive programming support for novices with dyslexia* and our collaborative study *Programming by Chat*.

**FSE:** Two collaborative papers published: *ScanCoder: Leveraging Human Attention Patterns to Enhance LLMs for Code* and *Stop the Retrieval Thrash: Brain-Guided Episodic Memory for Repository-Scale Coding Agents* (HumanAISE).
✈️ **Jun:** Attended **EASE 2026** in Glasgow, Scotland, UK!
**EASE:** Our collaborative paper *Locating Software Vulnerabilities With Static Analyzers: How Far Are We?* was published.
**CSCW:** Our paper *Contribution Patterns in Open Source Software for Social Good: Dynamics, Individuals, and Impact* was accepted!
**TOSEM:** Our eye-tracking study *Novices Comprehending Functional vs. Imperative Programs* was published.
**IEEE TSE:** Our research on the feasibility of webcam-based eye tracking for code comprehension was published.
🎓 **Apr:** Successfully presented my Ph.D. dissertation proposal at Vanderbilt University!
**ASE (NIER):** Our collaborative paper *CodeACT-R: A Cognitive Simulation Framework for Human Attention in Code Reading* was accepted.
✈️ **Jun:** Attended **FSE 2025** in Trondheim, Norway.
🎓 **Jun:** Helped support the inaugural [**HumanAISE 2025**](https://humanai4se.github.io/) workshop, co-located with FSE 2025.
**FSE (SEET):** Our paper *A Comparative Study on ChatGPT and Checklist as Support Tools for Unit Testing Education* was accepted!
Received the **Vanderbilt Ignite Grant** and **LIVE Horizon Grant** to support research and educational innovation.
🏆 Received the **C. F. Chen Best Paper Award** from Vanderbilt University's Department of Computer Science.
Awarded the **Richard Bennett/Dorothy Danforth Compton Prize Scholarship**.
**CSCW:** Our paper *"Math Is a Pain!": Understanding Challenges and Needs of the Machine Learning Community on Stack Overflow* was published.
🏆 **FSE:** Our paper *A Four-Year Study of Student Contributions to OSS vs. OSS4SG with a Lightweight Intervention* received the **ACM SIGSOFT Distinguished Paper Award**!
Received an **NSF Student Travel Award**.
